searchText: One more last tests update https://github.com/ethereum/tests/releases/tag/v17.2 We have the `blockchain_test_engine` format in our releases, that we use for within the `eest/consume-engine` simulator against a fully instantiated client: https://hive.ethpandaops.io/#/group/fusaka-devnet-0 I'd be in favour of clients creating a runner for these tests (like they do for the `blockchain_test` format) in the future! The format is defined here: https://eest.ethereum.org/main/consuming_tests/blockchain_test_engine/ I wont push hard for it though as we get more coverage with the hive simulator We are not currently running this type of test in hive but we can and should. Planning to get the default `engine` simulator back up to speed to for Fusaka

excerpts.author: spencer_tb
excerpts.content:
We have the `blockchain_test_engine` format in our releases, that we use for within the `eest/consume-engine` simulator against a fully instantiated client: https://hive.ethpandaops.io/#/group/fusaka-devnet-0

I'd be in favour of clients creating a runner for these tests (like they do for the  `blockchain_test` format) in the future! The format is defined here: https://eest.ethereum.org/main/consuming_tests/blockchain_test_engine/

I wont push hard for it though as we get more coverage with the hive simulator
